script.full_text: Most people enter a room and become part of its atmosphere. A few arrive carrying one of their own. They do not chase attention. They do not negotiate their center. Their discipline has weight. Their clarity changes distance. Their presence gives disorder something to organize around. Build enough structure inside that the room stops being the main variable. You are not here to absorb the room. You are here to alter its gravity...
